column1: # ISO_EXPECTED_REFUSALS.tsv -- rosetta-pascal: entries whose dialect is ISO (ALL.dialect reads iso: fpc -Miso cut the ref) and that ISO 7185
# refuses, each graded as an EXPECTED REFUSAL exactly as fpc_tests grades one (CEO-1228): PASS in a mode when that mode refuses it with an
# ISO 7185 diagnostic; an acceptance, or a refusal without the diagnostic, is red; the fpc-cut ref is never compared and the denominator is
# unchanged. The ceo's ruling CEO-1657 (2026-10-11) on hq_pascal's ask: a program's dialect is decided once for the whole program; ISO 7185
# 6.2.1, 6.1.7 and 6.2.2.1 on the FPC System names are rules of the ISO dialect only, so an entry whose dialect is FPC, ObjFPC or Delphi is
# never listed here. corpus_suite_harness.py run reads this file beside ALL.pas (LANG_CONFIGS pascal expected_refusal_re).
# MEASURED 2026-10-11 by hq_pascal, every row: fpc 3.2.2 -Miso compiles it rc=0 from a scratch copy; scrip refuses it rc=1 in m3 (--run) and
# m4 (--compile) naming the clause in column 3 (the first diagnostic). Columns: entry <TAB> fpc -Miso <TAB> ISO 7185 clause <TAB> measured on.
